description: Two sections, each giving four uncorrelated random voltages that change together on a trigger, and two inverters beside them

params.text: Changes the four random voltages of that section by hand

inputs.text: A trigger changes the four random voltages of that section

outputs.text: One of four uncorrelated random voltages, held until the next trigger of that section
The voltage at the inverter input of that section multiplied by -1
